name: Unlock Arena Lockboxes
teaser: This is a simple mod that allows you to unlock the Epic and Common lockboxes that came with the new 3.10.5 update.
description_html:
This mod allows you to unlock the new Arena Lockboxes that do not have a current recipe within the Workshop.

**3.11 Adds the Arena Lockboxes with their own crafts. I will not be updating this mod to accomodate and it will always be for 3.10.x**

Workshop Lv 2 is required just like the Rare lockboxes that have a recipe already.

To Install: Just drag and drop the folder from the zip into your main SPT folder and voila, profit!

This is my first mod so hopefully it works well for everyone. I tested this both on a fresh install and on my own current profile with success.

Any issues let me know!
